text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《真正简易英语》
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《真正簡易英語》

text: the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 这个播客用简单的英语进行真实对话，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 這個播客用簡單的英語進行真實對話，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
You can watch this podcast with subtitles on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上观看带字幕的播客视频，
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上觀看帶字幕的播客影片，

text: bbclearningenglish.com,
where you can also find a free worksheet.
zh: 在那里你还可以找到免费的练习册。
zh_hant: 在那裡你還可以找到免費的練習冊。

text: Hi Georgie.
Hello Neil.
It's getting towards the end of the year.
It is.
How are you feeling about that?
Well, there's a few things that I wanted to achieve that I haven't,
zh: 嗯，有几件我想做成的事还没做成，
zh_hant: 嗯，有幾件我想做成的事還沒做成，

text: so I don't feel good about that, but I'm feeling quite festive and ready for those celebrations.
zh: 所以我对此感觉不太好，但我现在心情很喜庆，准备好迎接那些庆祝活动了。
zh_hant: 所以我對此感覺不太好，但我現在心情很喜慶，準備好迎接那些慶祝活動了。

text: What about you?
Yeah, time flies, as we say.
zh: 是啊，就像我们常说的，时光飞逝。
zh_hant: 是啊，就像我們常說的，時光飛逝。

text: It's the end of the year again.
And that is what we're talking about today
zh: 这就是我们今天要聊的话题
zh_hant: 這就是我們今天要聊的話題

text: in this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 在这期《真正简易英语》里。
zh_hant: 在這期《真正簡易英語》裡。

text: Shall we start?
Yes.
Have you had a good year, Georgie?
Yes, Neil.
I've had a great year.
I've been very busy.
I've had a few trips,
and I've also turned 30, so I've had a big birthday.
zh: 而且我还满30岁了，所以过了一个很重要的生日。
zh_hant: 而且我還滿30歲了，所以過了一個很重要的生日。

text: What about you?
How's your year been?
Yeah, it's been pretty good.
I went to your 30th birthday party.
zh: 我去了你的30岁生日派对。
zh_hant: 我去了你的30歲生日派對。

text: You did.
That was definitely one of my highlights.
zh: 那绝对是我今年的亮点之一。
zh_hant: 那絕對是我今年的亮點之一。

text: Was it?
Talking of highlights,
so highlights are the most important or interesting thing.
zh: 亮点就是最重要或最有趣的事情。
zh_hant: 亮點就是最重要或最有趣的事情。

text: What have your highlights been this year?
Well, my 30th birthday was probably one of my highlights
zh: 嗯，我的30岁生日可能是我的亮点之一
zh_hant: 嗯，我的30歲生日可能是我的亮點之一

text: because I had friends and family from all over.
zh: 因为我的家人和朋友从各地赶来。
zh_hant: 因為我的家人和朋友從各地趕來。

text: I basically invited everyone I knew,
zh: 我基本上邀请了我认识的所有人，
zh_hant: 我基本上邀請了我認識的所有人，

text: which is why you got the invite.
And yeah, that was something that I was quite proud
zh: 而且，那件事我挺自豪的
zh_hant: 而且，那件事我挺自豪的

text: of because I am not a very organized person.
zh: 因为我不是一个很有条理的人。
zh_hant: 因為我不是一個很有條理的人。

text: And with this, I was very organized.
What's been the highlight of your year, Neil?
zh: 你今年的亮点是什么，尼尔？
zh_hant: 你今年的亮點是什麼，尼爾？

text: Oh, well, that's a tricky question.
zh: 哦，这个问题有点难回答。
zh_hant: 哦，這個問題有點難回答。

text: But I did go on a fantastic holiday with my family.
zh: 不过我和家人度了一次很棒的假期。
zh_hant: 不過我和家人度了一次很棒的假期。

text: We went to Sicily.
Wow.
And it's so beautiful.
And the food was amazing.
And is there anything you're proud of this year?
zh: 那你今年有什么让你自豪的事吗？
zh_hant: 那你今年有什麼讓你自豪的事嗎？

text: Proud of?
Yeah, I'm always proud of my kids.
zh: 是啊，我一直为我的孩子们感到自豪。
zh_hant: 是啊，我一直為我的孩子們感到自豪。

text: They make me feel proud.
Yes, they had a good year.
And yeah, they both did well in their own way at school.
zh: 嗯，他们俩在学校都以自己的方式表现很好。
zh_hant: 嗯，他們倆在學校都以自己的方式表現很好。

text: Oh, that's nice.
And how about you?
Well, I talked about being proud of my 30th birthday party,
zh: 嗯，我说过我为我的30岁生日派对感到自豪，
zh_hant: 嗯，我說過我為我的30歲生日派對感到自豪，

text: but I also performed at the Royal Albert Hall, which is a big, famous music hall in the UK, in London.
zh: 但我也曾在皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅演出，那是英国伦敦一座大型且著名的音乐厅。
zh_hant: 但我也曾在皇家阿爾伯特音樂廳演出，那是英國倫敦一座大型且著名的音樂廳。

text: I didn't sing as a soloist.
I sang with my choir at the BBC Proms,
zh: 我是和合唱团在BBC逍遥音乐节上唱的，
zh_hant: 我是和合唱團在BBC逍遙音樂節上唱的，

text: which is a big music festival.
Wow.
How did it feel to sing in front of all those people in that incredible setting?
zh: 在那么多人面前、在那么棒的场合唱歌，感觉怎么样？
zh_hant: 在那麼多人面前、在那麼棒的場合唱歌，感覺怎麼樣？

text: It felt incredible.
And I had lots of people I knew in the audience, actually.
zh: 而且观众里有很多我认识的人，真的。
zh_hant: 而且觀眾裡有很多我認識的人，真的。

text: Some of our colleagues came.
Yeah.
It was, the atmosphere was incredible and I'll never forget it.
zh: 那种气氛太棒了，我永远不会忘记。
zh_hant: 那種氣氛太棒了，我永遠不會忘記。

text: Wow.
So, Georgie, is there anything that you
zh: 那么，乔吉，今年有没有什么你
zh_hant: 那麼，喬吉，今年有沒有什麼你

text: didn't do this year that you wanted to do?
Yes, lots.
I had lots of plans at the beginning of the year,
lots of New Year's resolutions, like running.
zh: 很多新年决心，比如跑步。
zh_hant: 很多新年決心，比如跑步。

text: I wanted to run more.
I have not been running very much,
so I regret not doing more running.
And also my sugar intake.
We all know that I eat too much sugar,
zh: 大家都知道我吃糖太多，
zh_hant: 大家都知道我吃糖太多，

text: and I wanted to reduce my sugar intake,
but I find it too difficult.
So I regret not reducing my sugar intake.
zh: 所以我后悔没减少糖的摄入。
zh_hant: 所以我後悔沒減少糖的攝入。

text: Well, you stopped having sugar in your coffee, at least.
zh: 嗯，至少你咖啡里不放糖了。
zh_hant: 嗯，至少你咖啡裡不放糖了。

text: That's true.
What about you, Neil?
Well, a
bit like you, I wanted to do lots of running.
zh: 跟你有点像，我也想大量跑步。
zh_hant: 跟你有點像，我也想大量跑步。

text: Actually, I wanted to get really fit this year,
zh: 其实，我今年想变得很健康，
zh_hant: 其實，我今年想變得很健康，

text: and I haven't, because I hurt my ankle and I can't run,
zh: 但我没有，因为我伤了脚踝跑不了，
zh_hant: 但我沒有，因為我傷了腳踝跑不了，

text: and running is my main way of keeping fit.
zh: 跑步是我保持健康的主要方式。
zh_hant: 跑步是我保持健康的主要方式。

text: So I need to find something else to do.
Yeah. Time now to recap some of the vocabulary
zh: 是的。现在是时候回顾一些词汇了。
zh_hant: 是的。現在是時候回顧一些詞彙了。

text: we've heard in this episode,
zh: 我们在这一期里听到的，
zh_hant: 我們在這一期裡聽到的，

text: starting with highlight.
And a highlight is the best bit of something.
zh: highlight就是某件事中最好的部分。
zh_hant: highlight就是某件事中最好的部分。

text: So the highlight of my year, Georgie, was my trip to Sicily.
zh: 所以尼尔的年度亮点就是西西里之旅。
zh_hant: 所以尼爾的年度亮點就是西西里之旅。

text: Or was it your 30th birthday?
If you are proud of something, it means you feel good about something you've done.
zh: 如果你为某事感到proud，就是你对做过的事感觉很好。
zh_hant: 如果你為某事感到proud，就是你對做過的事感覺很好。

text: You can also be proud of someone else.
zh: 你也可以为别人感到自豪。
zh_hant: 你也可以為別人感到自豪。

text: For example, Neil is proud of his kids.
zh: 比如，尼尔为他的孩子们感到自豪。
zh_hant: 比如，尼爾為他的孩子們感到自豪。

text: And if you regret something,
you feel sad about it and wish that you had done it differently.
zh: 你为它感到难过，希望自己做得不一样。
zh_hant: 你為它感到難過，希望自己做得不一樣。

text: For example, I regret not running more.
I'm not very fit.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这一期《真正简易英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 這一期《真正簡易英語》就到這裡。

text: Try the worksheet to test what you've learnt at bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 在bbclearningenglish.com上试试练习册，检验你学到的东西。
zh_hant: 在bbclearningenglish.com上試試練習冊，檢驗你學到的東西。

text: We'll be back in the new year for more real conversations in Easy English
zh: 我们新年后再见，带来更多简易英语的真实对话
zh_hant: 我們新年後再見，帶來更多簡易英語的真實對話

text: to help you learn.
Have a really great end to 2025.
Happy New Year!
